newsitem.title: INDIA: India's ITC jumps 9.0 pct near close.
newsitem.headline: India's ITC jumps 9.0 pct near close.

text.p: Shares of tobacco firm ITC Ltd surged 40.50 rupees, or nine percent, to 477 near close of trade on the Bombay bourse on Monday, traders said.
"The market is very short. Some speculators have realised that and are squeezing the shorts," said a trader at a foreign brokerage.
Some speculators covered their short positions in early trade after a leading U.S. fund turned buyer in the stock late last week.
ITC shares attracted a backwardation charge -- which indicates a short position -- in the carry forward account ended May 31.
"It was the third consecutive backwardation," the trader said. "Along with ITC, everything is following suit."
Traders said large investors were on the sidelines ahead of an impending hike in prices of some petroleum products.
ITC said recently its net profit climbed to 3.43 billion rupees in the financial year ended March 31, 1997, from 2.6 billion in the previous year.
